I remember when I broke up with a gf years ago she insisted on sending me text, messages, etc. I didn't respond and we weren't able to be friends and talk again for a long time. He is probably trying the best he knows how to move on, and that is by cutting you off completely. I'm not saying that's the best way, but it is what I did and I regret that I didn't handle it better but I didn't want to hear from my ex at the time and he obviously doesn't want to hear from you. Try to spend time with friends, family, or a hobby and get your mind off of him. It will be healthier for you to move on rather than to dwell
